entities.summary: Mehmed Said Galip Pasha was an Ottoman statesman. He was Grand Vizier of the Ottoman Empire from 13 December 1823 to 14 September 1824. He was a signatory of the Treaty of Paris (1802) with France, ending the French campaign in Egypt and Syria.
